description: This file provides an API interface for wizard configuration and agent onboarding in a web UI, including functions to get and submit wizard data, start onboarding, check agent status, and complete setup, with mock data support for development environment.

methods.name: getWizardInfo
methods.description: Fetches wizard configuration data, using mock data in development.

methods.name: submitWizardConfig
methods.description: Submits the wizard configuration data to the server.

methods.name: startAgentOnboarding
methods.description: Initiates agent onboarding process with specified method.

methods.name: getAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of the agent onboarding process.
